title: Discarded Wine Bottle
summary: Use the bottle and make a DC 15 Medicine check. On success it becomes Master Meztil’s Karabasan’s Gift; failure reveals a poison smell.

fields.Use: Use the bottle and make a DC 15 Medicine check. On success it becomes Master Meztil’s Karabasan’s Gift; failure reveals a poison smell.
